Also scaffolds no-op stubs for the nine tool modules and raw-ddl.ts — see the header comment. Pre-declares every v1 npm dep per spec §6.1 (no downstream plan ever edits package.json or bun.lock).

Corpus and roots tools, first-run wizard, snapshot tool for change-since-last-open, sqlite3-mcp register integration. Owns the scholar.dashboard view-opener (registered from corpus.ts per the §7.6 mapping).
Ingestion adapters and tools: @retorquere/bibtex-parser (BibTeX) + in-house RIS adapter in src/server/ingest/bibtex.ts (§5.14), CrossRef DOI, arXiv, manual entry.

plan.synopsis: Text extraction, chunker, Ollama embeddings, chunk_vec + reading_queue raw DDL, hybrid search, reading queue, digest and reading-prompts generation. Cycle order is load-bearing: 6.5 fills runRawDdl to materialize chunk_vec, then 6.6 extends raw-ddl.ts with the reading_queue view (see header comment). Owns the scholar.paper.show, scholar.digest.show, scholar.prompts.show, and scholar.progress.show view-openers (registered from papers.ts / digest.ts / prompts.ts per the §7.6 mapping).

Annotation CRUD with bidirectional reconciliation against the child pdf MCP. Schema-compatible with the Daisy round-trip. §13 reconciler discipline is load-bearing: phase-1 reads → phase-2 MCP I/O → phase-3 db.transaction(...) with no awaits inside the closure.

MCP App UI bundle (five React views, host styling, single-file build via Bun's HTML bundler — no vite.config.ts) and the user-facing nu module, slash commands, and skills. Cycle 6.9 emits the per-dep KB measurement that gates the §14.1 bundle-budget remediations.

scripts/build-plugin.ts to assemble the .plugin archive — orchestrates the seven §14.1 build steps (server compile, UI bundle, pdf vendor copy, Bun runtime copy, vec0 build, nu copy, plugin zip). The first-run PDF-root wizard is owned by the corpus plan, not packaging.
